name: raven-mcp
description: Design intelligence for Claude — design principles, UI patterns, content design systems, business strategy, and production design system tokens.
long_description: Raven gives Claude a design knowledge base it can query while generating UI. Five layers: principles (Nielsen, Laws of UX, Gestalt, WCAG, typography, color, mobile UX, D4D, UX writing), patterns (signup, pricing, nav, forms, landing, dashboard, modals, empty/error/loading states, CTAs, social proof, mobile conversion, plus content patterns for error messages, empty-state copy, notifications, and form validation), content design systems (Mailchimp, GOV.UK, Shopify Polaris, Atlassian, Intuit voice & tone guides), business strategy (monetization, retention, onboarding, growth, metrics), and production design tokens (Stripe, Linear, and more). Claude calls Raven's tools automatically when you ask it to build, evaluate, or improve UI.
